status: MODEL (planning operator rows + planning token time); not a measurement
question: per token, how much FLOP and how many bytes each model moves per operator class, and which operators need compute versus bandwidth

definitions.perTokenPerRank: global rows are divided by TP, as laneTimes does; the arithmetic intensity is TP-invariant
definitions.bound: compute when the row's FLOP/byte is at or above the core class's machine balance (peak x utilization x duty cycle / MC effective bytes per second); collective rows are classified by the network against tau
definitions.ratios: each ratio is one domain's own lane time as a fraction of the raw budget; they do not add up (raw = max(memory lane, serial lane))
definitions.intensityHistogram: buckets over FLOP/byte, with the operators in each bucket
